license.notes: Factory roadmap 267. The walker, 2026-10-20: 'stanchion or stanchions are likley more common for banks and indoor common areas', 'metal barriers are for outdoor concerts or riot protection from police', 'retractable belt stanchion', and a photo -- black posts on round weighted bases, a flat black belt taut between each pair at waist height, lanes switching back in front of a desk. REFERENCE: the common retractable-belt queue stanchion -- a 38 in post 2-1/2 in across on a 14 in weighted base 2 in high, a cassette head, a 2 in belt, 7-1/2 ft of reach -- black powder coat. One straight run a slot: posts along its width, one belt through them (`core/stanchion_run_forms.py`). The base stands 3 cm proud of a building's 2 cm floor skin (Zoo 1.118.1's lesson). Collision: the posts and the belt line; a body cannot walk through, a shot above or below the belt passes. BUILT: 168 tris for a two-post run, 246 at the default 4.6 m, 558 at 12 m (2026-10-20).
